note: B8 v2 sector input-output technical-coefficient seed slice (ai-agents.md §18.2 v2, §18.5 role `prior`). SEED VALUES PENDING OWNER-CONFIRMED REFRESH. Each row is a monetary technical coefficient a (EUR of the input sector consumed per EUR of the output sector's production) with the source dataset and vintage named verbatim for citations; the rate method converts it to physical units via the product/material price ratio (r = a x u_p / c_m). Free-tier sources only; never fetched at runtime - this file is code, reviewed and versioned like code (the leiSeed.json / estimatorBenchmarks.json discipline). Changing any row requires bumping the consuming rate method's version in estimators.ts (§18.1 failure-mode law). match_tokens are matched against the NORMALIZED material name; the composite row (empty match_tokens) is the deterministic fallback.
